SELECT batter,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_runs IN (4, 6) THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) / SUM(batsman_runs), 2) AS boundary_percentage
FROM deliveries
GROUP BY batter
HAVING SUM(batsman_runs) >= 500
ORDER BY boundary_percentage DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_players
FROM (
    SELECT batter
    FROM deliveries
    GROUP BY batter
    HAVING SUM(batsman_runs) >= 1000
)

SELECT bowler, COUNT(*) AS ball_count
FROM deliveries
WHERE extras_type IS NULL OR extras_type NOT IN ('wides', 'noballs')
GROUP BY bowler
ORDER BY ball_count DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT batter, SUM(batsman_runs) AS runs
FROM deliveries
GROUP BY match_id, batter
ORDER BY runs DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(total_runs) AS total_powerplay_runs
FROM deliveries
WHERE "over" BETWEEN 0 AND 5

WITH team_runs AS (
  SELECT m.season, d.batting_team AS team, SUM(d.total_runs) AS runs
  FROM deliveries d
  JOIN matches m ON m.id = d.match_id
  GROUP BY m.season, d.batting_team
), ranked AS (
  SELECT season, team, runs,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY season ORDER BY runs DESC, team ASC) AS rn
  FROM team_runs
)
SELECT season, team, runs
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY season
